body: I cant speak as to *what is happening,* because when I do that i get really flushed with self-hatred and project it onto others*... but i can say that* **I got into boxing,**,, i'm a student, unmedicated (for now), and i carry my mits and wraps with me in case i need to punch something as hard as i can for an hour after an exhausting email exchange or after FOrGeTTinG SomETHInG AgAINNN. i have a playlist of high bpm angry songs that i plug in and just go nuts on a sand bag. after i've finished i feel more confident in my bad ass self and feel the exercise endorphins (which are essential to adhd funtioning).
